Located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], '''Lake Anre''' was a prehistoric lake that ran via underground tributaries all the way to the [[Northern Dune Sea/Legends|Northern Dune Sea]] [[Desert/Legends|desert]].<ref name="Inside" /> By [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|I}}, as depicted in ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]'', to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> Lake Anre had dried up and its bed had become a region of desert known as the [[Hutt Flats/Legends|Hutt Flats]].<ref name="Inside" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lake Anre was first mentioned in the [[2000]] reference book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]'', which was written by [[Kristin Lund]].<ref name="Inside" />
